title: Discovering Natural Transformation Vulnerabilities in Black-Box Vision Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.07110v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Natural adversarial examples (NAEs) reveal that vision models can fail under realistic semantic changes beyond norm-bounded perturbations. However, generating NAEs in a black-box setting remains challenging because existing generative attacks often rely on surrogate models, learned attack priors, or costly query-based optimization, whereas the natural transformations that expose model vulnerabilities are unknown a priori. We propose \textbf{Adversarial Scenario Attack (ASA)}, a query-based black-box framework that searches over natural-language editing scenarios using a multimodal language model and a modern text-guided generative editor. ASA jointly explores background, weather, and material/color transformations through winner--loser feedback, and uses a greedy explorer to compose only attack-improving scenarios. translated_title: 发现黑盒视觉模型中的自然变换脆弱性
translated_abstract: 自然对抗样本（NAEs）表明，视觉模型在超出范数约束扰动的现实语义变化下可能失效。然而，在黑盒设置下生成自然对抗样本仍然具有挑战性，因为现有的生成式攻击通常依赖代理模型、学习到的攻击先验或代价高昂的基于查询的优化，而暴露模型脆弱性的自然变换是先验未知的。我们提出了对抗场景攻击（ASA），这是一个基于查询的黑盒框架，利用多模态语言模型和现代文本引导的生成编辑器在自然语言编辑场景中进行搜索。ASA通过胜者-败者反馈机制联合探索背景、天气以及材质/颜色变换，并使用贪婪探索器仅组合能够提升攻击效果的场景。在多种ImageNet分类器上，ASA相比以往基于查询的生成式攻击方法取得了显著更高的攻击成功率。
tldr: 提出了对抗场景攻击（ASA），一个基于查询的黑盒框架，利用多模态语言模型搜索自然语言编辑场景（背景、天气、材质/颜色变换）来生成自然对抗样本，在多种ImageNet分类器上取得了显著更高的攻击成功率。
en_tdlr: We propose Adversarial Scenario Attack (ASA), a query-based black-box framework that searches natural-language editing scenarios (background, weather, and material/color transformations) using a multimodal language model to generate natural adversarial examples, achieving substantially higher attack success rates than prior query-based generative attacks across diverse ImageNet classifiers.
